# Markdown formatting

- Write each prose sentence on its own physical line.
- Do not wrap a sentence across multiple lines, even when it makes a line long.
- Do not use Markdown formatting tools that soft-wrap prose sentences.
- Keep headings, list items, table rows, code fences, and HTML tags on their own lines.
- For a paragraph with multiple sentences, put each sentence on a separate line.
- Preserve Markdown structure and readability; do not split a single sentence just to limit line length.
